name: run
args: {"code":"const r=await bash({command:\"python3 - <<'PY'\\nimport json, pathlib, shutil, tempfile\\np = pathlib.Path('data/orders')\\nsnapshot = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='orders-before-', dir='/tmp'))\\nfiles = sorted(p.rglob('*.json'))\\nfor f in files:\\n    target = snapshot / f.relative_to(p)\\n    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\\n    shutil.copyfile(f, target)\\n    order = json.loads(f.read_text())\\n    if order['status'] == 'paid':\\n        order['itemCount'] = sum(item['qty'] for item in order['items'])\\n        f.write_text(json.dumps(order, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\\\n')\\nprint('Snapshot:', snapshot)\\nprint('Files:', len(files))\\nPY\"}); console.log(r.stdout);"}

name: run
args: {"code":"const results=await Promise.all([bash({command:\"python3 - <<'PY'\\nimport json, pathlib\\np = pathlib.Path('data/orders')\\nsnapshot = pathlib.Path('/tmp/orders-before-fjgowao9')\\npaid = other = 0\\nfor f in sorted(p.rglob('*.json')):\\n    before = (snapshot / f.relative_to(p)).read_bytes()\\n    after = f.read_bytes()\\n    original = json.loads(before)\\n    current = json.loads(after)\\n    if original['status'] == 'paid':\\n        expected = dict(original, itemCount=sum(item['qty'] for item in original['items']))\\n        assert current == expected, f\\n        assert after == (json.dumps(current, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\\\n').encode(), f\\n        paid += 1\\n    else:\\n        assert before == after, f\\n        other += 1\\nprint(f'Verified {paid} paid orders and {other} unchanged non-paid orders.')\\nPY\"}),bash({command:\"git diff --stat -- data/orders\"}),bash({command:\"git diff --check -- data/orders\"})]); for(const r of results) console.log(r);"}
